title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Senior BE Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**  

  

**About ETS:**  

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future\-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

  

POSITION SUMMARY:
  

  

We are looking for a talented and passionate back\-end engineer to join our team and work on Salesforce Commerce Cloud projects. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining high\-quality web applications that deliver engaging and personalized shopping experiences to our customers.
  

  

As a back\-end engineer, you will work closely with other developers, designers, and business stakeholders to understand the requirements and deliver solutions that meet or exceed expectations. You will also follow best practices and standards to ensure code quality, performance, and scalability.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  

* Design, develop, and implement scalable back\-end solutions for SFCC ensuring performance and reliability.
* Integrate Salesforce Commerce Cloud with third\-party services and APIs using RESTful web services, OCAPI, and custom cartridges
* Understand and optimize existing integrations with custom third\-party APIs.
* Manage and configure SFCC Business Manager to optimize product catalogs, promotions, and storefront performance. Debug and troubleshoot issues using browser developer tools, SFCC Business Manager, and other tools
* Perform code reviews, unit testing, and code deployment using Git, Jenkins, and other tools
* Collaborate with other developers, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-quality solutions
* Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in web development and Salesforce Commerce Cloud

**Experience and Skills:*** Proficiency in SFCC architecture including back\-end systems and data models
* Ability to implement customizations for complex business domains using ISML, JavaScript, and OCAPI
* Familiar with web services and APIs integration using RESTful, OCAPI, and custom cartridges
* Experience with code versioning and deployment tools such as Git, Jenkins, etc.
* Strong knowledge of web standards, accessibility, and best practices
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills
* Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer certification is a plus

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:


* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
* 6 years of experience in Salesforce Commerce Cloud development using SFRA, Pipelines, Controllers, Demandware Script, etc.

\#LI\-AD1


**ETS is mission driven and action oriented**

* We are passionate about hiring innovative thinkers who believe in the promise of education and lifelong learning.
* We are energized by cultivating growth, innovation, and continuous transformation for the next generation of rising professionals as leaders. Â In support of this ETS offers multiple Business Resource Groups (BRG) for you to learn and advance your career growth!
* As a not\-for\-profit organization we will encourage you to lean in to your passion for volunteering. Â At ETS you may qualify for up to an additional 8 hours of PTO for volunteer work on causes that are important to you!
* The base salary range advertised represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. The base pay is only one aspect of the Total Rewards Package that will be offered to the successful candidate.

**ETS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe in creating a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity.**

title: Research Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**


We're looking for a **Research Engineer, AI** to build the models and systems that make visa processing faster, more accurate and more reliable than ever before.


You'll take ideas from research to production, testing new approaches across LLMs, agents and document intelligence, and shipping the ones that move real outcomes like approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.


This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves going deep on hard AI problems, and who gets as much satisfaction from a system that works in production as from a clever idea.

**The Job**

* **Build AI systems that do real work** by designing and shipping LLM\-powered agents that reliably complete complex, multi\-step tasks across external tools, APIs and web interfaces.
* **Push the frontier of document intelligence** by building pipelines that extract, verify and reason over information from unstructured documents and images with high accuracy at scale.
* **Define how we measure AI quality** by building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and datasets that show how accurate, reliable and safe our models are across the long tail of real\-world cases, before and after they ship.
* **Run experiments that change decisions** by comparing models, prompting strategies, fine\-tuning approaches and routing logic to improve accuracy while reducing latency and cost.
* **Own systems end to end** by taking work from prototype to production, including data pipelines, inference infrastructure, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop fallbacks for when models aren’t confident.

**The Ideal Candidate**


You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 3\-6 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work building and shipping ML or LLM\-based systems in production.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and comfortable with the modern AI stack, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent frameworks.
* Have hands\-on experience with LLMs in practice, including prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, tool use and evals, and understand where each approach works and where it breaks.
* Bring a research mindset with a bias to ship: you form hypotheses, run clean experiments, read papers when they help, and turn results into systems people use.
* Have exposure to document AI, OCR, large\-scale data pipelines, or making inference fast and cost\-efficient at scale.

**What you can expect**


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

**Here's what you can expect:**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

title: Technical Head
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Toll Plaza Operations \& Database Lead** to manage the technical operations of live toll plaza systems, including **database administration, transaction processing, lane systems, production support, failover/DR and team coordination**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage technical operations of live **toll plaza and lane systems**, ensuring uptime, availability and transaction continuity.
* Administer and troubleshoot **Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL** databases.
* Handle **SQL queries, stored procedures, indexing, performance tuning, blocking, deadlocks and database connectivity** issues.
* Manage **HA, failover/failback, replication, backup, restore and Disaster Recovery (DR)** activities.
* Monitor and troubleshoot **FASTag/RFID, ANPR, Lane Application, Lane Controller, Barrier, WIM/AVC and payment systems**.
* Investigate **missing, duplicate, failed, pending and mismatched toll transactions** and maintain data integrity.
* Take ownership of critical **production incidents**, perform root\-cause analysis and coordinate with software, network, server, hardware and OEM teams.
* Lead **Shift Engineers, Database/IT Support and Field Engineers** and coordinate with clients, system integrators and NOC teams.
* Monitor **lane availability, database/server health, transaction processing and SLA compliance**.
* Prepare **RCA, operational reports and corrective/preventive action plans**.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **6–12 years** of relevant experience in database administration, production support or toll/ITS operations.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL**.
* Good knowledge of **Database HA, Failover, Replication, Backup \& DR**.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident\-management skills.
* Working knowledge of **FASTag, RFID, ANPR, ETC, Lane Systems, WIM/AVC and MLFF**.
* Basic understanding of **Windows/Linux, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, VPN and firewall**.
* Strong **team leadership, client coordination and problem\-solving** skills.
* Experience in **Toll Plaza / Highway ITS / Transportation Technology / System Integration / MLFF** will be preferred.

**Qualification**

**BE/B.Tech / MCA / BCA / B.Sc. IT / Computer Science / Electronics** or equivalent relevant experience.

**Key Performance Areas**

System \& Database Uptime \| Lane Availability \| Transaction Integrity \| Database Performance \| DR/Failover Readiness \| Incident Resolution \| SLA Compliance

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Embedded IoT Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, modify, test, and maintain embedded firmware for IoT products and connected devices.
* Develop firmware applications using **ESP32, STM32, or other microcontrollers**.
* Write efficient, reliable, and maintainable **Embedded C/C\+\+** code.
* Interface microcontrollers with sensors and peripheral devices.
* Work with embedded interfaces and protocols including **UART, SPI, I²C, GPIO, PWM, ADC and RS485/Modbus**.
* Implement sensor data acquisition, processing, validation, error handling, and diagnostics.
* Develop and debug **Wi\-Fi and GSM/LTE\-based IoT communication**.
* Implement device communication with gateways and cloud/server APIs using **MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS** and related protocols.
* Work on firmware features including **OTA/FOTA updates, watchdog, RTC, configuration management and device diagnostics**.
* Analyze existing firmware and implement enhancements, fixes, and performance improvements.
* Debug firmware and hardware\-related issues using serial logs, debugging tools, and test equipment.
* Support sensor calibration, validation, reliability testing, and troubleshooting of field issues.
* Participate in unit testing, integration testing, and product\-level firmware validation.
* Work closely with **Hardware, QA/Testing, Software, Production, and Service teams** during product development and deployment.
* Support hardware\-firmware integration, PCB bring\-up, and troubleshooting where required.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation covering firmware, interfaces, configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Support investigation of recurring field failures and contribute to root\-cause analysis and corrective actions. The existing KRA specifically emphasizes closing the loop on field failures and feeding corrective changes into subsequent product revisions.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Embedded Programming**

* Strong knowledge of **Embedded C/C\+\+**.
* Good understanding of:
* Pointers
* Structures and unions
* Arrays and strings
* Functions
* Memory management
* Bitwise operations
* Interrupts
* Timers
* State machines

**Microcontrollers \& Firmware**

* Hands\-on experience with **ESP32, STM32, or similar microcontrollers**.
* Experience with **ESP\-IDF, Arduino, PlatformIO, or similar frameworks/tools**.
* Understanding of firmware development, debugging, and version control.
* Experience with **Git**.

**Sensors \& Hardware Interfaces**

* Experience integrating sensors and peripheral devices.
* Knowledge of **UART, SPI, I²C, GPIO, PWM, ADC, RS485 and Modbus**.
* Ability to read basic circuit diagrams and understand hardware interfaces.
* Understanding of sensor data acquisition, parsing, validation, and error handling.

**IoT Communication**

* Hands\-on experience with **Wi\-Fi and/or GSM/LTE** communication.
* Understanding of **MQTT, HTTP and HTTPS**.
* Basic understanding of **TCP/IP and REST APIs**.
* Exposure to device\-to\-gateway and device\-to\-cloud communication.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* relevant hands\-on embedded systems, IoT, firmware: 3 years (Preferred)

Location:

* Delhi (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Associate - AI/Data Engineer (PEG Alpha)
description:
**About us**


Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.


In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.


**Who you will work with**


BCN Private Equity Group CoE at Bain \& Company provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast\-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching \>250 members today from \~10 members in 2013\. We operate from 3 locations – 2 in India and 1 in Poland, and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set\-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought\-partner with daily deliverables.


**What you’ll do**


* Build and maintain data models, schemas, transformation layers, and reusable data components that support analytics and AI\-enabled applications.
* Develop and integrate AI/LLM\-based capabilities such as Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, information extraction, summarization, copilots, and agentic workflows.
* Build robust ingestion, transformation, validation, and enrichment pipelines to prepare enterprise data for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI use cases.
* Work with relational, NoSQL, analytical, and vector databases to support application, analytics, and AI workloads.
* Develop APIs, services, and reusable components that enable applications and AI systems to securely consume data and model capabilities.
* Implement retrieval pipelines using embeddings, vector search, metadata filtering, reranking, and other techniques to improve the relevance and quality of LLM\-powered applications.
* Support the evaluation and monitoring of AI/LLM solutions using appropriate datasets and metrics to assess retrieval quality, response quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Apply software engineering best practices including modular design, automated testing, version control, documentation, code review, and CI/CD.
* Optimize data and AI workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost across development and production environments.
* Implement appropriate data quality, access control, security, privacy, and governance practices in line with Bain's organizational policies and responsible AI standards.
* Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, software engineers, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Troubleshoot data pipeline, application, retrieval, and model\-integration issues and contribute to improving the observability and reliability of production systems.
* Contribute to shared data and AI platform components, common libraries, data contracts, APIs, and engineering standards that can be reused across PEG Alpha products.
* Evaluate emerging AI/LLM technologies and frameworks and contribute to technical decisions based on solution quality, scalability, security, maintainability, and cost.
* Use GenAI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalent) responsibly to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and technical documentation while reviewing generated outputs against team engineering standards.
* Should be Familiar with Pyspark, DataLake, Snowflake, Airbyte frameworks.

**Who you are**


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4\-5 years of relevant professional experience in data engineering, AI/ML engineering, software engineering, or related technical roles, with hands\-on experience building data\-intensive or AI\-enabled applications.
* Strong programming skills in Python, with experience developing production\-quality data or AI applications.
* Experience designing and developing ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured datasets.
* Good understanding of data structures, data modelling, database schema design, data quality, and scalable data processing.
* Hands\-on experience with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or equivalent.
* Experience working with data processing and analytics technologies such as Pandas, PySpark, Spark, Databricks, or equivalent frameworks.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform – AWS, Azure, or GCP – and its data/AI services.
* Understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) concepts, including prompting, embeddings, tokenization, context management, and model APIs.
* Experience developing or integrating RAG\-based applications, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.
* Familiarity with vector databases/vector search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector, Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or equivalent.
* Understanding of techniques for improving retrieval and LLM application quality, including metadata filtering, hybrid search, reranking, prompt engineering, and structured outputs.
* Familiarity with AI/LLM application frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, data architectures, and AI approaches to colleagues and stakeholders from different disciplines.
* Curiosity, proactivity, critical thinking, and a strong willingness to learn emerging data and AI technologies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and multi\-office/region teams.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset and ability to work through ambiguous technical and business requirements.
**What makes us a great place to work**


We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity, and a model of social responsibility. We are a Glassdoor Best Place to Work, and we have maintained a spot in the top four since its founding in 2009\. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities, and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.

title: Senior Associate – Data Engineer (Data Business CoE)
description:
**About us**


Bain \& Company is a global management consulting that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.


In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

  

  

**Who you will work with**


OPEXEngine, a Bain \& Company solution, is a proprietary B2B SaaS benchmarking database covering 1,200\+ participating SaaS companies, 250\+ metrics, and 130,000\+ validated data points. The platform ingests customer submissions, calculates financial, SaaS, go\-to\-market, headcount, and operating expense metrics, and publishes cohort\-level benchmarks that Bain case teams and external customers use to identify performance gaps and prioritize where to improve.


The Senior Associate will work as a hands\-on data engineer on the OPEXEngine data team, supporting end\-to\-end delivery across data ingestion and validation, metric calculation, and cohort and benchmark creation, while ensuring high\-quality, scalable, and reliable data solutions.

  

  

**What you’ll do**


This role requires strong hands\-on experience in SQL, Python, relational data modeling, and data warehousing. The candidate will design and implement data pipelines, data models, and validation workflows, and is expected to scope features and make architecture decisions rather than execute only within a pre\-defined scope.


The role includes active participation in project planning, stakeholder communication, and quality assurance to support timely delivery of high\-impact work. Full\-week coverage is required, with overlap into US working hours to support the onshore team.


The BCN Senior Associate will work closely with team managers, OPEXEngine Strategy \& Ops leadership, Bain case teams, and external customers to build and deliver scalable, automated, and commercially relevant data solutions.


The working style of the team is centered on scalable product and capability development; therefore, pipelines and data solutions built in this role should be robust, automated, and designed for long\-term maintainability. The individual should also be comfortable creating structure in ambiguity.


**Essential Functions:**
* Validate incoming customer submissions for structural accuracy and consistency with the OPEXEngine taxonomy, flagging exceptions for review.
* Load validated responses into the OPEXEngine database and action corrections arising from customer feedback or direction from Strategy \& Ops.
* Write and optimize SQL\-based queries and transformations to support metric calculations, data checks, and deliverables for Bain case teams and external customers.
* Operationalize the annual benchmarking cycle: build cohorts from defined selection criteria, calculate benchmarks and quartiles, validate the output, and ensure it is published to the platform.
* Design and execute data cleaning rules that improve structural validity across the benchmark database.
* Scope, design, and build platform features that strengthen the data pipeline, such as validation tooling that flags taxonomy breaks and percentile performance views across the database.
* Make schema and architecture decisions across the ingestion, metric calculation, and benchmarking pipeline, ensuring solutions are scalable, automated, and maintainable.
* Gather business requirements and process knowledge from Strategy \& Ops, and translate them into scalable data models, transformations, and outputs aligned to end\-user needs.
* Investigate data issues within the pipeline, identify root causes, communicate implications to stakeholders, and propose effective solutions.
* Prepare clear technical and process documentation for ongoing maintenance, knowledge transfer, and future reference.
* Manage communication with onshore teams and stakeholders regarding project progress, data quality, and key insights.
* Support project planning and resource management, including prioritization, work allocation, and tracking progress across concurrent initiatives.
* Provide technical guidance and day\-to\-day support to junior team members, review output for quality, and drive reusable capability building through shared assets, frameworks, and documentation standards.
  
  

**About you**


Work experience: 6\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Management, Business Intelligence, or Business Analytics, with strong hands\-on experience in SQL, Python, data warehousing, and relational database design.


Education Required: Incumbent should be a graduate/post graduate from a top\-tier institute or have pursued a statistical/analytical course from a tier 1 university.


Preferred: Concentration in a quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, Business Analytics, or Market Research is strongly preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:**


* Advanced SQL knowledge (complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, optimization, etc.).
* Strong hands\-on Python for data processing, validation, automation, and scripting.
* Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data warehousing principles, and relational database architecture, with hands\-on experience on SQL server or a comparable relational database.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies, preferably AWS (e.g., EC2, RDS, CloudWatch).
* Strong understanding of data modeling, schema design, and scalable data pipeline architecture.
* Ability to independently scope features, design solutions, and make architecture decisions, including where requirements start out ambiguous.
* Experience with Git\-based version control and CI/CD workflows; GitLab experience preferred.
* Experience coordinating projects, managing resources, and driving execution across multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to provide technical leadership, coach junior team members, and review output for quality and accuracy.
* Strong organizational skills, including planning, prioritization, and time management.
* High attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Passion for solving complex data problems and working with large, diverse data sets.
* Ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, and business contexts.
* Good to have (not mandatory): SaaS domain expertise or P\&L fluency, and prior experience with benchmarking or survey\-based data sets.
* Good to have (not mandatory) : familiarity with PHP or JavaScript/React for full\-stack contribution, and exposure to LLM/API integration.
  
  

**What makes us a great place to work**


We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. title: Senior Analyst, Incident Management
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------


Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations. **NICE TO HAVE*** ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.
  

Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**IT Service Management Knowledge**

* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.
* Strong command of RCA methods including 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, timeline analysis and contributory\-factor analysis.

**Technical Knowledge**


* Broad operational understanding of enterprise networks, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD\-WAN, VPN, DNS, load balancing, firewalls and connectivity services.
* Working knowledge of cloud, data centre, virtualization, compute, storage, databases, middleware, messaging, APIs, identity, monitoring and application support.
* Ability to interpret monitoring alerts, logs, service dependencies, transaction flows, change records and technical recovery plans.
* Awareness of cybersecurity incident interfaces, business continuity, disaster recovery and regulated or safety\-critical service environments.
* Ability to lead technical specialists effectively without being the deepest subject\-matter expert in every technology domain.

**Management \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional incident leadership, command\-and\-control, facilitation and prioritization under time pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive summaries and customer\-facing updates.
* Strong analytical reasoning, structured problem solving, attention to evidence and disciplined decision\-making.
* Influencing, negotiation and conflict\-resolution capability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in a global, virtual and matrix organization.

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
---------------------------

**Major Incident Leadership:** Establishes control rapidly, sets priorities, drives decisions and maintains momentum until stable service is verified.

**Customer \& Business Orientation:** Understands business impact and balances technical recovery, operational risk, contractual commitments and customer experience.

**Operational Excellence:** Applies repeatable controls, accurate records, measurable standards and evidence\-based governance.

**Problem Solving \& Judgement:** Synthesizes incomplete information, challenges assumptions and makes timely, risk\-informed decisions.

**Process Integration:** Connects incident learning to Problem, Change, Knowledge, Event, Service Level and Continual Improvement outcomes.

**Transformation \& Improvement:** Identifies systemic gaps and converts lessons into sustainable improvements, automation and improved ways of working.

**Stakeholder Leadership:** Influences global teams, suppliers, customers and leaders through credibility, clarity and constructive challenge.

**Data \& Insight:** Uses operational metrics, trends and quality analysis to target improvements and demonstrate benefits.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**
---------------------

* Accountability and ownership
* Customer centricity
* Collaboration and inclusion
* Integrity and professional courage
* Agility and resilience
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Results orientation
* Learning mindset and continuous improvement
* Composure under pressure
* Attention to detail and quality

**EDUCATION \& QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

* Diploma or certificate in computer science, electronic engineering, telecommunications, or an equivalent local qualification
* Bachelor’s or university degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
* ITIL Foundation Certificate

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex\-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.  

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.  

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. *SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

title: Senior Detection Engineer
description:
Talanos Cybersecurity delivers managed SOC, identity governance, third\-party risk management, dark web intelligence, continuous autonomous pentesting and security advisory services to mid\-market and regulated organisations across the UK, Europe, South Africa, Botswana and India. We are CREST SOC accredited and certified ISO 27001 and ISO 9001\.

We are building a dedicated Detection Engineering function and this is its founding role. We need someone who can engineer detections across enterprise SIEM platforms and who can also understand a customer's business well enough to know which detections actually matter to them. You will work across multiple SIEM platforms and sectors, with direct access to the CTO and real influence over our in\-house product roadmap.

**What you'll be doing**

* Baseline and improve detection coverage for assigned customers against MITRE ATT\&CK and their own risk profile
* Author, test, version and maintain detection content across multiple SIEM platforms
* Determine the log sources and telemetry needed for a given detection outcome and troubleshoot integrations, parsers and data quality
* Work directly with customers to translate their business risk into monitoring requirements a SOC analyst can act on
* Build the correlation layer that connects our security services to one another (e.g. turning dark web credential exposures into tuned identity detections)
* Track the threat landscape and build a reusable detection library so work for one customer raises the baseline for all

**What you'll need**

*You don't need to tick every box below, but most of these should describe you:*

* 6\+ years in cybersecurity, with real hands\-on experience in security operations, SIEM engineering or detection content
* Deep, practical experience with at least one enterprise SIEM (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, Elastic Security, Google SecOps, Sumo Logic) and confidence working across more than one
* Demonstrable experience authoring detection logic in a query language such as KQL, SPL, EQL, Lucene, YARA\-L or Sigma
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK used for coverage and gap analysis, not just as a reporting label
* Practical understanding of log sources across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, identity systems, network, email and EDR
* Ability to hold a credible conversation with a customer about their business and convert it into monitoring requirements
* Clear written and spoken English

**Nice to have**

* Python or PowerShell scripting; detection\-as\-code workflows using Git and CI pipelines
* Purple team experience, or use of Atomic Red Team, Caldera or a commercial breach and attack simulation platform
* Structured, hypothesis\-driven threat hunting experience
* Identity security experience (identity governance, privileged access, privileged account monitoring)
* Cloud or detection certifications (AZ\-500, SC\-200, AWS Security Specialty, GCDA, GCIA, GCFA, GCED, OSCP)

**What we offer**

* Genuine ownership of a new discipline, reporting directly to the CTO
* Breadth across multiple customers, sectors and SIEM platforms
* A funded training and certification budget
* Standard business hours, no shift work and no on\-call rota (with regular calls overlapping into the UK afternoon/evening, roughly 1:30pm\-9:30pm IST)
* A clear path to leading the function as it grows

To apply, please submit your CV along with a short note on one detection you personally designed and built: what it was for, what evidence it relied on, and how you knew it worked.

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹250,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

* Describe a detection you personally designed and built. What was it for, what evidence did it rely on, how did you confirm it worked?
* Which SIEM platform(s) have you personally authored detection content in (not just administered), and which query language(s) have you used (e.g. KQL, SPL, Sigma)?

* This role involves occasional travel to Delhi (roughly once a month) and regular working hours that overlap into the UK afternoon/evening (approx. 1:30pm\-9:30pm IST). Are you comfortable with this?

It also fosters collaboration across functions, drives adoption of data tools, and contributes to a stronger, more mature data culture across the organization.

 **The Challenge**

  

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

 **Responsibilities**

  

We are seeking a motivated **Senior Data Engineer** to join our **ITOS Function**. In this role, you will be responsible for.

* **Design, Develop, and Maintain Data Infrastructure**  

Build and maintain scalable, secure, and efficient data pipelines, storage layers, and integrations on Azure. Ensure the platform can support both current reporting needs and future analytical use cases.
* **Technical leadership, Data enablement \& Literacy:**

* **Stakeholder Collaboration and Solution Design**

* Consultant collaboration: Act as primary point of contact for external consultants, overseeing project development, ensuring adherence to technical standards, and facilitating timely issue resolution
* **Platform Visibility and Adoption**  

Promote internal awareness and usage of Cotton Cloud by supporting onboarding, documentation, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* **Governance, Quality, and Compliance**  

Ensure the platform adheres to data governance standards, including security, privacy, data quality, and access controls.
* **Continuous Improvement and Innovation**  

Identify opportunities to improve system performance, adopt new tools, or enhance platform capabilities to meet evolving business needs.

 **Experience**

 **Education \& Experience:*** A degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* At least 3 years of relevant data engineering experience.
* Proficiency in ETL, SQL, and a programming language such as Java, C\#, or C\+\+.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory, GitHub CI/CD, and relational/NoSQL databases.
* A track record of building and delivering data solutions on Azure.
* Understanding of BI tools and practices, and ideally experience with Power BI **and** Salesforce.

**Skills \& Competencies (Outcome\-Driven)*** Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Uses analytics to optimise workflows and improve efficiency.
* Process Improvement: Identifies gaps and implements solutions that enhance performance.
* Effective Communication: Tailors messages to engage, inform, and influence varied audiences.
* Change Agility: Responds proactively to shifting needs and organisational change.
* Collaborative Working: Partners across functions and geographies to deliver results.
* Inclusive Leadership: Cultivates an environment where diverse perspectives are encouraged and respected.

**Technical competencies (Role\-Specific, Outcome\-Linked)****1**. **Advanced Cloud Data Engineering (Azure)*** Expertise: Deep knowledge of Azure services such as Data Factory, Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, and monitoring tools.

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

 **Interviews:**


If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.

 **Assessment and Testing:**

 **Reference Checks:**

Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.

 **Offer stage:**


After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details.
